about: New-data queue (2026-09-30). One item at a time: fetch slowly, QC, run its registered A/B test, message the result on Telegram, then the next. Runner: src/agentic/research_queue.py (launchd com.sgm.research, hourly). State: logs/research_queue/state.json.

items.title: Promoter & insider trades (NSE moved to a new filing system on 1 May 2026; our feed has been empty since)
items.why: promoter market purchases in the last 90 days went with twice the winners and half the crashes in 2019-2022; the feed silently stopped, so 2026 is blank

items.title: Bulk-deal buyer names (which funds and known investors are buying)
items.why: who is buying matters more than that someone bought; NSE's historical bulk-deal list names the buyer

items.title: Shareholding detail: mutual fund, foreign fund and Indian institution stake changes, number of small shareholders (quarterly)
items.why: funds building a stake while retail shareholders shrink is the 'strong hands' pattern; the filings are already linked in stock_shareholding.parquet

items.title: Promoter pledges (released vs newly pledged)
items.why: a released pledge removes a forced-selling risk; a new pledge is a red flag

items.title: NSE surveillance lists (ASM/GSM) and price-band changes
items.why: small caps put on extra-margin lists mid-rally often stall; history may not be downloadable, then it is collected from today and paper-tracked
